v0.8-codex-survival.purpose: Preferred first three-card trial: early exile interaction, an answer to lethal attacks and the requested anti-swarm payoff.
swaps: Twilight needs seven mana to wipe and makes Mites that cannot block; Wurm can shrink opposing small creatures while keeping your tokens and is a Jace hit.
Keep Sunfall as the cheaper exile board wipe; add an instant nonland exile answer for recursive/indestructible threats. Costs 3 life and does not bypass hexproof.
Trade a six-mana delayed transformation spell for a four-mana defensive answer to attacking armies, including unblockable creatures. Cannot undo attack triggers; nontoken creatures can be recast.
v0.8-codex-survival.caveat: These are best-fit recommendations to trial, not measured individual upgrades. Losing Synthetic Destiny costs a real protection/polymorph option that Forge underuses. Wurm needs BBB when hard cast and does not sweep already-large tokens.

v0.8-codex-exile.purpose: Isolate two extra instant exile answers against large/recurrent creatures and troublesome nonland engines, keeping owned Despark.
swaps: Instant exile of any targetable nonland permanent; Sunfall retained for a full exile reset.
Two-mana creature exile without the 4+ mana-value restriction of Despark; opponent manifests a 2/2 that may turn face up.
v0.8-codex-exile.caveat: Two fewer mass effects; this may lose ground to wide boards. Exile does not prevent a commander returning to the command zone. Does not answer hexproof. Massacre Wurm is not in the physical baseline; this is an isolated alternate diagnostic, while the preferred survival list adds it.

v0.8-codex-swarms.purpose: Isolate a cheaper full creature reset and a one-sided small-creature payoff against Lathril/Krenko/Chatterfang.
swaps: Fresh 1/1 and 2/2 armies can die to the entry effect; preserves friendly fodder. Does not handle pumped larger armies by itself.
Four mana for a full creature wipe instead of requiring X>=5 (seven total mana).
v0.8-codex-swarms.caveat: Loses two token-making X spells; Wrath kills your own creature board and does not exile or beat indestructible. Sunfall and Overwrite retained. Wurm hard casting raises black requirements.

v0.8-codex-owned-engine.purpose: No-purchase diagnostic: add recurring blocking/fodder capacity and an owned payoff that has visibly prevented a loss.
swaps: Two-mana recurring Army source; one Army grows, with a new Army only after the old one is gone. Costs one life each upkeep.
Owned indestructible payoff: verified can’t-lose replacement saved a game at -1 life in C1 pod16-g4.
v0.8-codex-owned-engine.caveat: A nine-mana card can clog the hand. Army power grows above the current sim’s power-2 Jace exile limit. Removal of two expensive effects is a real tradeoff; no free card is automatically an upgrade. This alternate diagnostic does not buy/install Massacre Wurm; the preferred survival recommendation still includes Patrick’s requested Wurm.
